scope: Two rejection/control-flow inputs; no new geometry, original execution, replacement execution, or predicted model-state outputs.

required_baseline.protocol: Import this known tetrahedron fixture immediately before each rejection case, record the complete before snapshot, then import exactly one case and record its status/after snapshot. Reimport the baseline before the second case to isolate effects.

syntax_basis.header: Intentionally no dimension/header/object-creation/coordinate block. The preceding baseline supplies dimension3 and object1 with four existing nodes.
syntax_basis.ELMCON: Object ID, element count, requested arity10 followed by a labeled ten-integer row containing1..10. Baseline defines only four nodes; missing node coordinates are intentional because this is a rejection/control-flow probe, not a valid mesh.
syntax_basis.OBJNAM: Second fixture appends supported OBJNAM object ID and next-line name syntax.

cases.payload_classification: Sequential IDs1..10 solely as rejected-input payload. Baseline defines only1..4; IDs5..10 intentionally have no coordinates. This is not a valid ten-node geometry.
